source.stem:
A battery is connected to two crocodile clips and a lamp.
There is a gap between the crocodile clips.
Four cylinders W, X, Y and Z are made of the same metal but have different dimensions. The cylinders are connected in turn, by their ends, between the crocodile clips. The diagrams of the cylinders are all drawn to the same scale.
Which cylinder makes the lamp glow most brightly and which cylinder makes the lamp glow least brightly?

options.text: most brightly W; least brightly Y
most brightly W; least brightly Z
most brightly X; least brightly Y
most brightly X; least brightly Z

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The clips keep clinging after the current stops.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Putting the iron nail inside makes the electromagnet weaker.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Without the nail, the powered coil cannot deflect the compass.

mx.name: mechanism_conflation
mx.teacher_note: The cold electromagnet cannot pick up clips until its nail heats up.

intelligence.enrichment: A current-carrying coil behaves like a magnet, and placing an iron nail in the coil makes the electromagnet stronger. current flows through the coil -> the coil behaves like a magnet and deflects a compass; iron nail inside the coil -> stronger electromagnet -> iron or steel clips cling more strongly; current stops -> clips no longer cling The learner correctly applies this rule: A current-carrying coil behaves like a magnet, and placing an iron nail in the coil makes the electromagnet stronger. Wrapping wire around a nail makes the nail a permanent magnet whether or not current is flowing.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Electricity: magnetic and heating effects. The student must decide: Decide whether a current-carrying coil is acting as a temporary magnet and whether an iron nail core makes it stronger. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Supply exactly one complete tikzpicture. The stem must refer to that figure. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
